nodes.name: webpack.config.js
nodes.summary: Webpack build configuration for the NestJS API, bundling src/main.ts with swc-loader (decorator metadata), filesystem caching, and edition-dependent module aliases chosen via PACKMIND_EDITION.
nodes.languageNotes: CommonJS config selecting OSS vs proprietary alias maps at build time from an environment variable.

nodes.name: webpack.paths.base.js
nodes.summary: Exports a factory returning the base @packmind/* package alias map (accounts, standards, deployments, skills, etc.) shared by OSS and proprietary API builds.

nodes.name: webpack.paths.oss.js
nodes.summary: Extends base webpack aliases for the OSS edition, redirecting proprietary-only packages (linter, amplitude, plugins, marketplaces...) to the editions stub package.

nodes.name: webpack.paths.proprietary.js
nodes.summary: Extends base webpack aliases for the proprietary edition, mapping proprietary-only packages to their real source directories.
